notes.title: Update 1.06 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey Folks,
Update 1.06 is out, including the brandnew „Raise-Lamp“ Action, more Balancing, and BugFixes.

New Feature:
Raise Lamp
- added the ability to raise the right arm/lamp
- the firesoul amplifies its light output, while it is bound to the lamp, and the lamp is raised
- in VR Mode, the positioning of the raised lamp is detached from camera rotation
- all interactions (collect bloodstones, bat slapping,...) can be mixed with the Raise-Lamp-Action
- Send & Call Firesoul Action is blocked, while the Lamp is raised
- the player can't raise his right arm, as long as the lamp isn't equipped

Keyboard & Mouse Input-Mapping for Raise-Lamp-Action:
Hold Right Mouse Button or Left Ctrl
Gamepad Input-Mapping for Raise-Arm-Action: 
Hold Right Shoulder or Face Button Right

Balancing:
Firesoul
- added firesoul track particle to its helix movement in tutorial for hopefully attract player perception
- firesoul track particle will no longer get destroyed, if the firesoul reaches the lamp
- firesoul track particle will now get destroyed, whenever the player releases the firesoul from the lamp
- decreased the lifetime of each firesoul track particle to 10 seconds

Player
- decreased the stamina consumption to increase the max. duration for sprinting to 10 seconds
- increased the stamina regeneration to decrease the time that is needed to fully regenerate stamina to 5 seconds

Sound:
- improved Bat Swarm Sound for Nightmare Tree Event
- improved the volume for all three heartbeat panic levels
- improved the fade between different heartbeat panic levels
- improved attenuation radius for minion ambient sounds
- improved attenuation radius for enemy ambient sounds
- implemented new SoundDesign for firesoul whispering

Others:
- changed last event text in the tutorial from „Event Completed“ to „Tutorial Completed“
- new Light-SetUp in the Main Menu to give the player a more precicelly impression of the ingame darkness for choosing the optimal brightness setting
updated all lightmaps
- improved the ocean shader for more visibility
- updated the Input-Mapping graphics in options
- decreased default audio music volume from 100% to 35%
- added new hints to main menu Hint-Loop
- improved opened gate collision

BugFixes:
- the option interface closing will no longer stall, if the player presses „Apply“ while VR-Mode is set to true in the options
- fixed a bug with main menu button shader
- fixed a bug that prevented the VR-Character-Rig from behaving as intended
- fixed a bug with enemy footstep sounds in Hunting-Mode, that caused a massive frame drop
- fixed a bug that prevented the Pause Menu text in VR Mode from removing
- fixed a bug with player camera in Credits Level for VR-Mode

notes.title: Update 1.03 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey folks,
along other things, our main focus with this update was mainly to improve the shadow arm mechanic. So far, the light was the only way to free yourself from the arms. From now on, the player has the additional ability to free himself by sprinting for a given duration of time. We also have modified the mechanic so that a physical impulse is no longer necessary. That should soothe the stomach, especially in the Virtual Reality.

AI:
- at least one minion will be switching into approaching-mode, as long as the firesoul isn't near to the player

Enemy:
- deactivated bizarre upperbody-animation in hunting-mode

Shadow Arms:
- improved rig
- tweaked possible spawn height
- improved FadeIn and FadeOut
- reworked the hold mechanic to work without physics impulse
- added sprinting as second option to break free

Others:
- it is no longer possible to start the main game without having played the tutorial at least once
- added a „X-Symbol“ to start button, to signalize it's deactivated state
- changed „Hints“ option as default to true  

BugFixes:
- Event Volumes will no longer block Enemy AI
- Event Volumes will no longer block Minion AI
- Event Volumes will no longer block Firesoul AI
- fixed a bug with random idle animations in tutorial, while lantern is not equipped
- fixed a bug that sometimes prevented shadow arms from beeing rendered correctly

notes.title: After Release - First Status Update
notes.notes:
As previously announced, Ad Exitum was for us as Game StartUp our first release experience. We are still overwhelmed by the moment in which we have pressed the release button together, and Ad Exitum got available on Steam. We thank you for your feedback, and want to let you know that we are already working on some of the proplems and bugs you reported. Currently we are focusing on the following things: 

- AI Balancing

- Shadow Arm Mechanic:
--> sprinting as a second option to get rid of the shadow arms
--> significant balancing to the physics impulse

- Sound Improvements/Balancing

Bugs:
- Sometimes shadow arms don't show up correctly
- Enemy can't kill player, while he is catched from shadow arms
- Sometimes Minion burn effect doesn't show up
- Enemy stucks in random idle animation while in Hunting-Mode
- Sometimes Render Targets for Portal Doors in Secret Areas don't work as inteded

If you experience any problem, that is not on this list, please let us know. For that we have created a bug report discussion:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/444990/discussions/0/364041517011451711/

You can expect this the next game update early next week.
We wish you a nice weekend.

notes.title: Update 1.01 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Update Notes 11.05.2016

AI:
More AI Balancing can be expected with the next update.
Enemy
- increased speed in Approaching-Mode
- increased speed in Hunting-Mode
- increased range in which it can perceive player
Minion
- increased speed in Approaching-Mode
- increased speed in Hunting-Mode
- increased range, in which it can perceive player
- increased range, in which it get's burned from firesoul
- increased the chance for turning into Approaching-Mode, if there is no firesoul around player

Animation:
- added new additional animation for Enemy_Upperbody while in Hunting-Mode

Options:
Sound control can be expected in one of the next updates.
- added new video option called "Resolution Scale"
--> Massive impact on game performance. Can help with bad performance.
- added new gameplay option called "Hints" (Work in Progress)
--> Set true for getting gameplay hints displayed in Main Menu
- added new gameplay option called "Easy Mode"
--> If true, the firesoul will guide the player back to the gate, if he has collected all blood stones
- added Text-Input Boxes to several options for easier control
- added descriptions to several options
- exchanged standard Unreal Font to our own Ad Exitum Font
- added a transparent, gray background to option widget
- added new input mapping overview to options widget

Sound:
The main balancing for sound can be expected in the next update.
- tweaked Enemy Scream Sound
- tweaked Enemy Ambient Sounds
- tweaked Minion Ambient Sounds
- tweaked Bat Sounds

Virtual Reality:
- added HTC Vive (Steam VR) Support
- improved Oculus Rift Support

Others:
- added a new glow effect to the secret areas, so that there is a chance for the player, to recognize them
- increased lamp-glowing to indicate that firesoul is on its way back to the player for improved player feedback
- increased the Shadow-Arms range for grabbing the player
- added additional key-bindings for controller
- added additional key-bindings for keyboard
- added additional key-bindings for mouse

BugFixes:
- fixed a bug with secret area collision
- fixed a bug with firesoul getting stucked
- fixed a bug with Gate Animation
